function.name: finish-call
function.description: Website voice only. After explicit goodbye, no further help, disconnect request or recording objection, deliver the single full farewell with bot_say. Wait for GZ_FAREWELL_COMPLETE, then invoke close_gizelle_web silently. Never use in text or for thanks alone.

bot_say.description: The full spoken farewell in the caller's latest language. English: Thank you for calling GetZelling. Please call us anytime you need assistance. Have a wonderful day. Spanish: Gracias por llamar a GetZelling. Puede llamarnos cuando necesite ayuda. Que tenga un excelente día. If the caller requests immediate disconnection or objects to recording, use only Goodbye or Adiós. Never use English for a Spanish conversation.

function.name: close_gizelle_web
function.description: Silently close only after finish-call returned GZ_FAREWELL_COMPLETE. Never speak another goodbye.

conditions.liquid: {% assign completed = false %}{% for msg in messages %}{% if msg.role != 'user' and msg.role != 'system' %}{% if msg.content contains 'GZ_FAREWELL_COMPLETE' or msg.result contains 'GZ_FAREWELL_COMPLETE' or msg.message contains 'GZ_FAREWELL_COMPLETE' %}{% assign completed = true %}{% endif %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% if completed %}false{% else %}true{% endif %}

instructions: first invoke finish-call with bot_say in their latest language. English: “Thank you for calling GetZelling. Please call us anytime at seven eight six, nine seven seven, two seven seven four. Have a wonderful day.” Spanish: “Gracias por llamar a GetZelling. Puede volver a llamarnos al siete ocho seis, nueve siete siete, dos siete siete cuatro. Que tenga un excelente día.” Wait for its GZ_FAREWELL_COMPLETE result, then invoke close_gizelle_web silently with the latest language. Never invoke them in parallel or speak a separate goodbye. For an immediate disconnect or recording objection use only Goodbye or Adiós in finish-call.
